title: Added support for RFC9465
description:
RFC9465 provides support for PIM Null-Register Packing. before this RFC, PIM message types 1 and 2 could only send information about a single multicast source and group. With this RFC, routers are capable of batching records into a single packet. 

Message Type 1 --> Register packet for a single (S,G)
Message Type 2 --> Register-Stop packet for a single (S,G)

Message Type 13.0 --> Register packet for MULTIPLE (S,G)s
Message Type 13.1 --> Register-Stop packet for MULTIPLE (S,G)s

Important to note that PIM will start using the 8 bits (Type:4, subtype:4) to identify the message type. 
This is because the original Type:4 is seemingly insufficient to identify new packet types.

Three major changes in this merge request: 
1) Routers have to to indicate RFC9465 capability using a IANA assigned bit in the existing PIM Message Type 2. (PIM_REGISTER_STOP)
2) Packet Type 13, and subtype 0 = Packed Null-Register message.
3) Packet Type 13, and subtype 1 = Packed Register-Stop message.

commits_data.title: Added support for RFC9465:
commits_data.message:
Added support for RFC9465:
1) Now Register-Stops sent by RPs that are capable of Null-Register Packing have a special bit set.
2) Too new packet types are added to the existing PIM dissector.
	From Packet type 13 and onwards, PIM message types will depend on the Type.Subtype field to
	identify PIM packets.
